connector.name: Inbox Check - Email Deliverability Test
connector.registryDescription: Email inbox placement tests across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Mail.ru, Yandex (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ldm-inbox-check-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the live-direct-marketing account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
